title: ARE Research Learning Ontology

projections.inputs: verified benchmark registrations plus explicit successor lineage

product_capability.meaning: Turn measured reasoning failures and corrections into falsifiable hypotheses, reproducible experiments, and inspectable learning decisions.

definitions.meaning: A content-addressed, falsifiable explanation for an observed reasoning-engine behavior, including its mechanism, metrics, falsifier, provenance, and experiment template.
An immutable supporting, counterevidential, or inconclusive result bound to one hypothesis and one exact evidence source.
A reproducible baseline-versus-treatment protocol that names metrics, datasets, repetitions, success criteria, and stop conditions.
A deterministic assessment that selects the next research action from accumulated observations without changing the serving engine.

An immutable record that binds one implemented-and-verified improvement candidate to exact implementation bytes, evidence bytes, and its measured comparison so the same current candidate is not rediscovered.
A deterministic record that binds an exact failed benchmark result to improvement signals and falsifiable implementation hypotheses without adopting them.

An immutable dependency plan anchored to exact research questions, with owner, lane, stage and evidence criteria per task. Readiness is derived; completion requires a criterion-bound verifier. Work-state events do not dispatch agents or grant effect authority.

An immutable acyclic projection of research dependencies across exact record versions. Forward edges expose prerequisite order; feedback adds successor records rather than changing historical nodes. Logical order does not assert historical preregistration or proven causality.

invariants: Every observation binds one exact hypothesis and evidence source.
Research DAG edges point from prerequisite to dependent; descriptive ontology edges are not automatically scheduling dependencies.
Cross-iteration research lineage must be explicitly supplied with provenance; chronology, similar names and metric changes do not imply lineage.
DAG cycles, unresolved references and changed selected registration bytes fail closed.
A research frontier identifies open questions, not permission or readiness to dispatch work.
Counterevidence is retained and forces hypothesis revision before technique proposal.
A single anomaly cannot support a technique candidate.
Declared concept markers are diagnostic evidence, not a semantic oracle.
Only a current retention whose exact implementation and evidence bindings match may suppress reselection of the same candidate.
Retention binding drift makes the record stale and returns the candidate to the experiment frontier.
A passing benchmark creates no failure hypothesis, and a failed benchmark must bind its exact result digest.
Learning decisions never mutate, activate, publish, or deploy the engine.
